blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Former Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) parliament member Sultan Edrieza Nasser Rimbang denied involvement in the drug shipment intercepted in Laos as he appeared before the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI), saying he is willing to undergo a lie detector and drug test. “Nandito tayo para yung pangalan natin linisin natin na wala tayong kinalaman sa binibintang sa atin,” Rimbang told reporters in an ambush interview at NBI.
